Title: LSJ: CrimethInc and Undue Influence question

Messages.Author: Dasein
Messages.Body:
Say I have in my ready region Abd Al Rashid, who is an anarch, and
Anwar, who is not. Anwar is tapped after performing some action
(doesn’t matter which). I have in my uncontrolled region an Anarch
Convert.
Abd Al Rashid successfully performs the Undue Influence action at
quietus, and puts a counter on the Anarch Convert. The Convert is
moved into the ready region according to the Undue Influence card
text. Since he has “come into play”, I use the Anarch Convert’s card
text to remove him from the game and make Anwar an anarch.
Is there a window in the resolution of the action after the Convert
has come into play and made Anwar an anarch, where Abd al Rashid can
play CrimethInc action modifier at qui to untap a ready anarch i.e.
Anwar, who has just “joined the fold”?

Messages.Author: LSJ
